svg.title: World Bank Africa Projects Map — Full Stack Architecture
svg.desc: System architecture showing data sources, backend, geospatial processing, and frontend layers for a World Bank Africa projects map application

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I query the World Bank Projects API for Africa infrastructure projects?')
sendPrompt('Where can I download the AidData geocoded World Bank dataset?')
sendPrompt('How do I use the IATI API to get World Bank project locations?')
sendPrompt('Write me a Python ETL script to ingest World Bank project data and convert to GeoJSON with lat/long')
g.text: requests + pandas + geopandas → filter Africa → dedupe → GeoJSON output

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How should I set up PostGIS to store World Bank project geometries and metadata?')
sendPrompt('How do I generate Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF files from project bounding boxes for Africa?')
sendPrompt('How do I create a vector tile server with Martin or TiTiler for project location data?')
sendPrompt('Write me a FastAPI endpoint that returns World Bank projects in Africa as GeoJSON with filtering by sector and status')
sendPrompt('Write a FastAPI endpoint for project detail by ID including all World Bank metadata fields')
sendPrompt('How do I build a FastAPI endpoint that serves GeoTIFF tiles using TiTiler for a map overlay?')
sendPrompt('Write a FastAPI endpoint that generates a PDF report for a World Bank project with all metadata and map snapshot')
sendPrompt('How do I set up MapLibre GL JS or Leaflet with React to display GeoJSON project locations in Africa?')
sendPrompt('How do I add a click handler in MapLibre to show World Bank project details in a sidebar popup?')
sendPrompt('How do I add layer controls and sector filters to a React map showing World Bank projects?')

svg.text: Key data fields from World Bank API + AidData

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Show me all available metadata fields in the World Bank Projects API response')
sendPrompt('Explain the precision codes in the AidData geocoded World Bank dataset')
sendPrompt('What infrastructure and construction sector codes exist in World Bank project data for Africa?')
